sessions.pick_or_new: Choose a session or start a new one.
sessions.first_message: Send a message to start your first session.
sessions.chat_helper: Chat with the lead agent. It brings in team members when it needs them.
sessions.confirm_end: End this session and stop its members?
sessions.placeholder: Ask a question, give new instructions, or tell it to stop a member…
sessions.no_mirror: Replies appear here. They are not mirrored to the session's original channel.
sessions.still_answering: The lead is still answering your last message.
sessions.busy: The lead is still answering your last message.
sessions.team_helper: Each agent runs in its own container. Open one to see exactly what it can reach.
sessions.activity_hint: Team activity appears here as observations.
approvals.binding_notice: The approval is bound to this server, tool and argument hash. If the agent asks for anything different, it needs a new approval.
host.values_never_shown: Values can be set here but never shown.
approvals.empty.decided: No decisions from the last day.
approvals.empty.expired: No expired requests from the last day.
approvals.parse_unavailable: Command structure could not be parsed.
sessions.lead_note: The lead coordinates this session and owns its scope.
trace.choose_session: Open a session to view its trace.
host.skill_path: Skill directory path on this host
host.credential_saved: Credential saved. Its value will not be shown.
host.operation_failed: The operation could not be completed.
scope.ask_dismiss: Ask the lead to dismiss it
sessions.model_not_configured: No model is configured. Run microswarm init --lang en in the same MicroSwarm home, then try again.
sessions.chat_failed: The message could not be completed. Check the supervisor and model setup, then try again.
sessions.supervisor_unavailable: The supervisor is unavailable. Start microswarmd in the same MicroSwarm home, then try again.
host.search_unconfigured: Optional search is not configured. Run microswarm init and choose Tavily or Brave Search.
host.search_missing: Search credential is missing. Re-run microswarm init to configure it.
host.search_out_of_scope: web.search is not granted in the lead scope.
host.search_ready: {provider} is configured, its credential is present, and the lead scope allows web.search.
host.search_action: If your configured agent image predates web.search, rebuild it (default: docker build --tag microswarm-agent:dev --file images/agent.Containerfile .), restart microswarmd, then start a new session.
